name: concept-lab
description: Two skills for showing work on vyhouski.com. concept: an idea that is not built yet becomes a page from a Blender model, render-to-photo stills and a Seedance clip. showcase: a prototype or exploration that exists gets a repo if it has none, a licence check on bundled material, its PRs merged, real screenshots, a README, a findings doc and a draft page. Ships a hook that keeps concept photos Blender-first and commits clean.
